_readme: UI-chrome dictionary for generator.html/templates.html (the generator tool itself, not one of the manuals it produces — see js/generator/i18n.js). Keep en/pt/es with the exact same set of keys. NOT part of js/generator/package/file-manifest.js — never gets copied into a generated manual's own zip.
generator.title: Manual generator
generator.subtitle: Pick your colors, logo, and languages, watch the preview update as you go, then download a ready-to-serve .zip. No account needed, no server to set up.
generator.color.primary.hint: Links, the active menu item, the product name, buttons, and accents.
generator.color.secondary.hint: Borders and subtle backgrounds (menu hover/active, table stripes).
generator.contrast.warning: Low contrast (WCAG AA needs 4.5:1 or higher):
generator.status.missingFontHeading: Please upload a heading font file, or pick one of the built-in fonts instead.
generator.status.missingFontBody: Please upload a body font file, or pick one of the built-in fonts instead.
generator.preview.label: Live preview — your manual
generator.templates.title: Ready-made templates
generator.templates.hint: Browse the existing brand/layout combinations exactly as they ship — nothing to download here, just a way to compare options.
landing.title: HTML Manual Generator — build your own product manual
landing.subtitle: A no-account, no-server tool for turning this template into your own product manual.
landing.build.title: Build your own manual
landing.build.desc: Pick your colors, logo, favicon, layout, and languages, watch a live preview update as you go, then download a ready-to-serve .zip.
landing.browse.title: Browse ready-made templates
landing.browse.desc: See the brand and layout combinations that already ship with this template, exactly as they look out of the box.
generator.advancedColors.hint: Left on "auto", each piece below just follows the colors above. Turn a row off auto to set it independently.
generator.color.header.hint: The top header bar (also the top bar in the navbar/hybrid layouts).
generator.color.sidebar.hint: The sidebar column (sidebar/hybrid layouts), the nav column (scroll layout), or the dropdown submenu panel (navbar layout).
generator.color.navLinkBgActive.hint: Menu/submenu link background for the current page.
generator.color.navLinkTextActive.hint: Menu/submenu link text for the current page.
generator.color.searchResultsBg.hint: The dropdown that appears below the search box once you type something.
generator.color.searchResultsBorder.hint: The border of the dropdown that appears below the search box once you type something.
generator.color.searchResultsHoverBg.hin: The highlight behind a search result as you hover or arrow over it.
generator.color.controlBg.hint: The search box itself, plus the language/layout/brand dropdowns in the header.
generator.color.border.hint: Thin dividing lines across the page: under the header, above the footer, around form fields and images, between sidebar columns and sections. Also the search box's own border.
generator.color.tableBorder.hint: Cell borders in spec/comparison tables. Follows Borders above unless set here.
generator.color.tableHeaderBg.hint: The shaded header row in spec/comparison tables.
generator.color.calloutNote.hint: The accent border and title color of a "Note" callout box.
generator.color.calloutTip.hint: The accent border and title color of a "Tip" callout box.
generator.color.calloutCaution.hint: The accent border and title color of a "Caution" callout box (minor/moderate injury risk).
generator.color.calloutWarning.hint: The accent border and title color of a "Warning" callout box.
generator.color.calloutDanger.hint: The accent border and title color of a "Danger" callout box.
generator.desktopHint.title: For the best experience…
generator.desktopHint.body: This tool works on a phone, but the side-by-side form and live preview are easier to use on a larger screen, like a tablet or a computer.
generator.save.savedStatus: Saved — we'll remember this the next time you visit from this browser.
generator.save.restoredStatus: Restored your saved customization from last time.
generator.save.errorStorage: Could not save — your browser storage may be full or disabled.
generator.reset.confirm: This will erase your saved customization and restore every field to its default value. Continue?
